newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BetzDearborn begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BetzDearborn begun as buy.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said on Wednesday it started coverage of BetzDearborn Inc with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $76 per share.
-- Analyst Gilbert Yang said in a research note he expected the company to realize product line synergies, manufacturing efficiencies and cost efficiencies following the integration of Dearborn.
-- He forecast 1997 earnings of $3.06 per share and 1998 earnings of $3.70 per share.
-- In July last year, Betz completed its acquisition of the Dearborn water treatment unit of W.R. Grace & Co.
